base_pr.body:
Golf Hub silently ignored a browser launch returning false, while launch exceptions escaped eight course/booking button paths. A shared handoff now attempts the same URL once and displays a parented, readable warning with the exact plain-text address for manual opening. Successful launches, destinations, player/date context, cancellation and booking consent remain unchanged.

Stacked on #32 (`66eaf00f76e748cf6f76ef6a758574a3d996360c`). This is a desktop source repair; canonical source integration and installed-device validation remain pending.

Validation at `4fe841359f1d0b3e4a261649c286f04d0bfbac54`:
- Same final test file: baseline 11 passed / eight failed methods (24 assertion records); repair 19/19. Eleven added methods cover 32 browser-outcome subscenarios and missing-link/cancel/confirmed-plan guards. Original eight methods remain unchanged.
- Final local aggregate: **361 passed = 229 desktop + 95 cache/integrity + 37 additional**, 28 isolated processes; zero failures/errors/skips.
- Four actual offscreen modal cases: 68 assertions, short/long URLs at 980×640 and 1280×800. Separate keyboard expansion verification on PR32: 84 assertions and four intercepted BOOK callbacks; no expansion repair needed.
- Compile, actionlint, whitespace/artifact checks and independent review passed. All five workflows unchanged; only normal repair push/PR CI. All three exact-head CI runs passed on attempt 1; no failed/cancelled runs were returned by the complete all-event query.

[Full report and cumulative evidence](https://github.com/Jarryd22/golfhub-perth/blob/4fe841359f1d0b3e4a261649c286f04d0bfbac54/docs/qa/2026-11-20-browser-handoff/REPORT.md).

Preserved failures: three initial fixture ownership errors; a visually unreadable early warning despite passing tests; 24 intermediate selection-order failures, corrected without weakening tests; two automatic-focus failures also reproduced in plain Qt. Final retry probes explicitly reactivate the host. Native focus, clipboard, real browser/page loading, live bookings/holds and notification delivery were not tested. Historical Windows `cache_close` and canonical desktop/mobile reconciliation remain unresolved. No merge, release, deployment or production dispatch.

Exact-head CI:
- [Windows desktop push](https://github.com/Jarryd22/golfhub-perth/actions/runs/44651318146/job/136006627165): 229 tests, 21 isolated modules.
- [Windows desktop PR](https://github.com/Jarryd22/golfhub-perth/actions/runs/44651385641/job/136006857096): 229 tests, 21 isolated modules.
- [Linux cache PR](https://github.com/Jarryd22/golfhub-perth/actions/runs/44651385696/job/136006857485): 95 tests plus actionlint.

The pushed branch and PR head match `4fe841359f1d0b3e4a261649c286f04d0bfbac54`. PR merge `0308ba5ba253c7544bb63ea631e783f64daa90bb` has the expected parents and tree `4af8d47da7c848ef6d7549d273bfea80e8b71910`, equal to the tested repair tree. Main is unchanged; this PR remains draft/unmerged. Hosted Windows CI is source-test evidence, not installed-device QA.

Publication audit retained two optional encoded branch-metadata lookups rejected with HTTP400 INVALID_ARGUMENT and a missing local merge-object lookup. None was retried; prior permitted ref metadata, independent PR metadata and distinct Git commit/tree metadata verified the required publication facts. These were read-only lookup failures, not approval denials or uncertain writes.
